summary: Build your colony and lead your insects to victory in this strategy simulator!
description:
Build your own underground ant colony, breed various types of ants, and embark on thrilling adventures to survive in the wild forest. This real-time strategy simulator challenges you to manage your growing ant population while fighting hostile insects and conquering new territories. The path to success in this game lies in evolution, where you must adapt and evolve your colony's abilities to stay ahead of your enemies.

Features:

Strategy and simulator elements combine for a thrilling and deep experience.
Completely freestyle anthill building – Create the perfect home for your ants and expand it with resources.
Breed unlimited ants – From builders to gatherers and researchers, each ant has its own unique abilities.
Raids on enemy bases – Send your ants to fight hostile insects like termites, spiders, and even crabs!
Create your own deck of ants – 8 different types of ants available (with more coming soon).
30+ enemies including dangerous predators like termites, spiders, crabs, and other insects.
Difficulty levels – Choose Normal for a relaxing experience or Hard for a true survival challenge.
Realistic ant behavior – Watch your ants act intelligently and interact with the environment in a lifelike way.
Fight in the wild forest against waves of enemies and try to outsmart them with tactical strategies.
Evolve your colony – Your ant kingdom grows stronger over time, and your ants become smarter with each battle.
Smarty ants will use their intelligence to overcome obstacles and help you win challenges in the game.
Swarm mechanics – Lead your ants in large groups to overpower enemies and survive against greater numbers.
The game also features swarm mechanics where you can lead your ants in large groups to overpower enemies, while also battling dangerous creatures in the forest that will stop at nothing to destroy your colony. Evolution plays a key role as your ants adapt to different environments and new challenges, making each victory feel earned.

As a kingdom maker, you must guide your ant colony to prosperity. Conquer new areas, build new nests, and fight against other swarming insects to ensure the survival and growth of your colony. Your goal is to create a thriving ant civilization, evolve your ants to become stronger, and expand your territory as you advance through levels.

In Ant Colony: Wild Forest, every decision matters. Fight for resources, build your empire, and survive the challenges of the forest. Will you lead your legion of ants to victory, or will your colony fall to the dangers of the wild?
